why: Analysis 2's hedgehog sits closer to the key by pairing superstore operations with guided selling, measuring profit per store against Rival B and naming profit per region as the backup, and its three-arm format test is the more actionable way to renew the core. Analysis 1 covers the decline stages more fully, including warnings against a rebrand, an overnight end to commissions and mass cuts of salespeople, but the two are otherwise level on stop-doing, brutal facts and calibration.
